objective: Bound direct public visual access to a historical book-opening illustration without claiming a new original physical witness, and separate compilation, typecasting, publication and source-copy dates.

sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies, Korean Culture Encyclopedia
sources.observation: The public page gallery renders a book opening with the visible heading 交食推步法假令序; a separate page includes 交食推步法假令上 and 用數目錄. A cover image also appears. The gallery does not supply copy-specific original folio metadata to this review.

sources.observation: Entry describes publication in 1459; author 현정준, original 1995, last updated 2023-02-07. This does not source-attribute the gallery photograph.

sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies specialist 戊寅字 entry
sources.observation: The metal type was cast in 1458, for printing the large type of 交食推步法假令, and the rare copy is described as held by SNU Kyujanggak. Casting year is not itself physical-copy impression year.

sources.observation: 2017 南宗眞 translation 國譯 交食推步法, ISBN 9788982750243, table of contents lists 交食推步法假令序 and an original-text section labelled 교식추보법 원본; no book or target original image retrieved in this review.
